Another 10% allocation is proposed for Johnson & Johnson (market capitalization: $1,310,141,000,000), considering its diversified healthcare portfolio and reasonable ESG concerns. The remaining 15% of the equity allocation will be split between Visa Inc. (market capitalization: $510,314,000,000) and Procter & Gamble Company (market capitalization: $340,141,000,000), both of which have strong brand recognition and acceptable ESG profiles. The proposed equity allocations are within the 10% single-position limit and do not exceed the $10 billion market capitalization threshold. ESG screening has been conducted for each proposed position, highlighting the importance of responsible corporate practices.
